description: Java class containing various notification builder presets for Android Wear application, including stylized text, display intents, multi-size display pages, animated notifications, and content icon configurations.

classes.name: NotificationPresets
classes.description: A collection of nested classes defining different notification preset configurations.

methods.name: buildBasicNotification
methods.description: Creates a basic notification with title, text, icon, and content intent.

nested_classes.name: BasicPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a simple notification with multiple pages and actions.

nested_classes.name: StylizedTextPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a notification demonstrating stylized and formatted text content.

nested_classes.name: DisplayIntentPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a notification with a display intent set for wearables.

nested_classes.name: MultiSizeDisplayIntentPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a notification with multiple pages for different display sizes and custom heights.

nested_classes.name: AnimatedDisplayIntentPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a notification with animated display intent.

nested_classes.name: ContentIconPreset
nested_classes.description: Creates a notification with various content icons across pages.
